prompt:
Find real data on how many people actively use the Omarchy Linux distribution or how many times it has been installed. Cite the sources and quote any figures.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on the provided search results, there is no public data on the actual number of active daily users or unique installations of Omarchy; the available figures only measure ISO downloads, which the sources explicitly state overstate the retained user base. 

SOURCE: https://stealwhatworks.com/blogs/news/why-omarchy-blowing-up | QUOTE: "Omarchy currently does not publish a clean daily-active-user or retained-install figure that would let us measure this funnel properly." | CLAIM: Omarchy does not publicly release data on how many people actively use the OS or how many unique installations exist.

SOURCE: https://omarchy.us/news/2026/08/100000-downloads-in-a-week/ | QUOTE: "One hundred thousand downloads of the Omarchy ISO in the past week!" | CLAIM: Omarchy recorded 100,000 ISO downloads in a single week.

SOURCE: https://omarchy.us/news/2026/09/quattro-crosses-200000-iso-downloads/ | QUOTE: "Two hundred thousand ISO downloads of Omarchy Quattro in just 18 days!" | CLAIM: The Omarchy Quattro release reached 200,000 ISO downloads in 18 days.

SOURCE: https://exa.ai/library/podcast/2fcpbmjslqh/episode/5vkwc1sslv7 | QUOTE: "The adoption numbers are the reason Daniel noticed 1,165,980 ISO downloads in year one." | CLAIM: Omarchy reached over 1.1 million total ISO downloads in its first year.

SOURCE: https://www.panews.io/articles/01a0855c-f312-70ef-b5d1-eb2cf87f5c1e | QUOTE: "Omarchy ISO downloads have approached nearly 10,000 per day via Cloudflare CDN, and many images are being used to create multiple Omarchy devices." | CLAIM: Omarchy sees roughly 10,000 ISO downloads per day, though a single image may be used for multiple installations.

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: The exact number of unique installations or actively retained daily users of Omarchy.
